notes.title: Chinese localization in sZone-Online!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31334231/c8b4f036798404fa7b396258cd6903dcdd027aa5.jpg[/img]

For all stalkers-friends from China, first version of the Chinese localization of sZone-Online is also ready.

To change a language in Steam, right-click on the name of the game, select "Properties", then the "Language" tab and the desired language from the list.

If you are playing on the RU server, go to the root folder of the game, then:

packs\SettingsUser.xml

In the <CurrentLanguage> line enter the desired language (Chinese, English or Russian).

For example,

<CurrentLanguage>Chinese</CurrentLanguage>

is the Chinese version of the game.

The official website of sZone-Online is also translated into Chinese. To change the site language, open the "Profile", then "Account" and select the language ("Lang.") In the upper right part of the window.

https://szone-online.so/account/

Have a good game!

notes.title: Patch #0.03
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31334231/32d30385ec250e5b5cfc33bd6780180f1eb78659.jpg[/img]

1. Added a new type of anomaly: a bomb that attacks buildings, not players. By driving a car into such an anomaly, you can push it to the enemy base (the color of the anomaly changes from red to blue).

2. Added night time.

3. Improved handling, reduced drifts.

4. Shooting from the motorcycle "Hans" and the car "Volga" was changed. Now, if you release the fire button, the shooting stops.

5. Now the mini-map displays terrain and anomaly markers.

6. Improved camera rotation.

7. Improved turret rotation.

8. Improved grenade flight.

9. The color of the trace from the shots is no longer dependent on the team.

10. Fixed the bug of the disappearance of the jump effect.

11. Added new sounds, fixed old ones.

12. Corrected sound settings.

13. Fixed inventory bugs.

14. Other interface fixes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31334231/df099ddecf3ab457aae609240dd37b83308e6c63.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch №0.02 for ZoneDriver
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o751U207sCAoJQU3S/giphy.gif[/img]

Less than a week has passed since the release of the game in early access, but thanks to the detailed feedback received from our players, the first update is already here:

1. Added destructible objects: houses, towers, bridges.

2. Anomalies have been added to the "Deliver to Base" mode.

3. The speed of anomalies reduced.

4. With some probability an artifact falls from the destroyed anomaly.

5. Anomalies no longer attack the central gun.

6. The central gun can no longer be destroyed.

7. Removed the need to create or join a squad for the "Deliver to Base" mode.

8. Game objects such as bases and generators are now destroyed in pieces during the explosion.

9. Fixed a bug of falling through the bridge in the mode "Destroy the Base".

10. Fixed the turret that flew above ground.

11. Now the screen displays the time before the match starts. The start of the match is accompanied by a corresponding message.

12. During the replay, a message was added to the screen.

13. The blur effect is disabled during replays.

14. Changed the behavior of the camera during replays, added a smooth transition from one player to another.

15. Added a countdown before the next fight.

16. Reduced the font in the logs during the game session. The text in the log no longer pops out of the window.

17. The maximum amount of coins increased to 999,999.

18. Added exit button and help button.

19. Added setting for smooth fps change.

20. Other fixes of the interfaces.

21. Localization fixes.

notes.title: ZoneDriver is available!
notes.notes:
Be the first to check not only imperfect graphics and modest content of the new game, but also such unique features as "psychological test for selection of friends and rivals" and "eye tracking without using devices from a third-party manufacturer".

ZoneDriver, with all its pros and cons, is available to everyone at a special starting low price. No pay-to-win mechanics, no lotteries, loot boxes and other "schemes"!

[b]The game does not pretend to be perfect and does not try to be a substitute for your favorite entertainment, but it can give you several hours of fun if you give it a chance.[/b]

The development will continue! Your help will be appreciated! The best models created through the Workshop will expand the world of the racing Zone.

Try your first battle on flying vehicles today!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31334231/a62ed7ccccb3db48615d0b1c9e9ae40fda5b5021.jpg[/img]
